header.privacyWarning: Security notice: This tracking link includes your secret access token. Keep it private and do not share it publicly.

tokenGate.title: Enter Your Order Access Token
tokenGate.subtitle: To protect your privacy, viewing order {{orderNumber}} requires the secret access token sent to your confirmation email.
tokenGate.tokenHint: You can find this token or direct tracking link in your order confirmation email.
tokenGate.requiredError: Please enter your order access token
tokenGate.invalidError: Invalid access token for this order. Please double-check the full token from your confirmation email.
tokenGate.rateLimitError: Too many verification attempts. Please wait 15 minutes before trying again.

notFound.title: Order Not Found
notFound.message: We couldn't find order {{orderNumber}}. Please check the order number or contact our support team.

timeline.title: Order Progress

pending_payment.title: Order Created — Awaiting Payment
pending_payment.description: Complete your payment and upload the transfer receipt (or finish online checkout).

awaiting_review.title: Payment Proof Under Review
awaiting_review.description: We received your receipt and our team is verifying the transfer.

paid.title: Payment Confirmed
paid.description: Your payment is approved and repository access is being provisioned.

delivered.title: Project Delivered
delivered.description: Your license and source repository access have been delivered.

timeline.freeOrderNote: Free order (100% discount coupon) — automatically confirmed upon checkout.

rejected.title: Payment Proof Was Rejected
rejected.description: Please review the reason below and upload a clearer image or PDF of the valid transfer receipt.

expired.title: Order Expired Due to Unpaid Window
expired.description: The payment window for this order has elapsed. You can place a fresh order from the project page at any time.

cancelled.title: This Order Was Cancelled
cancelled.description: This order has been cancelled and can no longer be paid. Contact support if you need help.

refunded.title: Order Refunded
refunded.description: This order has been marked as refunded. Reach out to support if you need further assistance.

manual.proofSubmittedDesc: Your receipt is currently under review by the Nexus team. This page refreshes automatically.
manual.dropLabel: Drag & drop receipt image or PDF here, or click to browse
manual.dropHint: Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF up to 4 MB
manual.referenceInputPlaceholder: e.g. VF-TXN-987654 or last 4 wallet digits
manual.proofRequired: Please attach your receipt image or PDF first.
manual.invalidFileType: Unsupported file type. Allowed formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF.
manual.fileTooLarge: File exceeds the 4 MB size limit.
manual.uploadSuccess: Payment proof uploaded! Your order is now awaiting review.

fawry.title: Fawry Payment Reference
fawry.instructions: Visit any Fawry outlet or open the myFawry app, select Fawry Pay, and settle your order using this reference code:
fawry.pendingNote: Once paid via Fawry, the gateway confirms your order automatically within minutes.
fawry.missingReference: Your Fawry reference was sent to your confirmation email when the order was placed. Check your inbox or contact support if you need it re-sent.

card.pendingBody: If you just completed 3D Secure verification on Paymob, confirmation can take a few seconds via webhook — this page updates automatically.
card.noRetryNote: For security, expired or interrupted card sessions cannot be retried on the same order. If your payment failed or was aborted, please contact support or place a new order.

free.title: Auto-Confirmed Free Order
free.description: A 100% discount coupon was applied — no payment required.

pending.title: Awaiting Payment Confirmation
pending.description: Repository invitation and delivery setup begin immediately once payment is verified.

granted.title: Repository Access Granted!
granted.description: A collaborator invite was sent to the Git account on your order. Check your inbox or GitHub/GitLab notifications to accept.

manual.title: Manual Provisioning In Progress
manual.description: Payment is confirmed! Our team is provisioning repository access for your Git username and will send details shortly.

failed.title: Automated GitHub Invite Failed
failed.description: Your payment is confirmed, but the automated Git invite could not be sent (possibly an invalid username). Contact support with your order number for immediate manual access.

review.title: Rate Your Experience
review.subtitle: Your verified buyer review helps other teams evaluate this platform.
review.namePlaceholder: Leave blank to use your order name
review.nameHint: Publicly masked for privacy (e.g. Ahmed M.)
review.commentPlaceholder: Share your feedback on code quality, documentation, delivery speed, and support...
review.ratingRequired: Please select a rating from 1 to 5 stars
review.commentMin: Review comment must be at least 5 characters
review.commentMax: Review comment must be 2,000 characters or fewer
review.submitSuccess: Thank you! Your verified review is now live.

alreadyReviewed.title: You Already Reviewed This Order
alreadyReviewed.description: Thank you for sharing your feedback with Nexus! One verified review is allowed per order.

summary.title: Order Summary
summary.supportSubtitle: Talk directly with our engineering team

verifying.title: Verifying payment with our server...
verifying.description: For financial security, we confirm your payment directly against the authoritative webhook status before marking the order paid.

paid.title: Payment Confirmed!
paid.description: Your payment has been verified and recorded. Redirecting to your order tracking page in {{seconds}}s...

pending.title: Payment Processing
pending.description: We are still awaiting final webhook confirmation from the payment gateway. You can monitor live status updates on your order tracking page.

failed.title: Payment Not Completed
failed.description: The payment gateway reported a declined or cancelled transaction. Your order remains unpaid in pending status.

missingToken.title: Order Located — Verify Access Token
missingToken.description: Paymob returned you for order {{orderNumber}}, but no access token was found in this browser session. Enter the token from your confirmation email to view your authoritative order status.

missingOrder.title: Incomplete Payment Return Parameters
missingOrder.description: No order number was found in the payment gateway return URL. Enter your order number and secret token below, or browse our projects.
